# infrawrench_idle_finding_settings (Resource)

Tuning for the metric-based idle rules behind Potential savings: idle NAT gateways, load balancers, caches, provisioned tables, databases, clusters and unused custom metrics. Each rule reads the provider's metrics over the lookback window once a day; the rules and their thresholds are declared by the provider plugins and listed by `GET /idle-findings`.

An organization **singleton**, with no DELETE on the route: `terraform destroy` leaves the stored settings alone. Any change makes every account due for a fresh collection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_idle_finding_settings" "this" {
  enabled       = true
  lookback_days = 21

  rules = {
    # Flag NAT gateways that sent under 10 MB in three weeks.
    "aws:nat-gateway" = {
      thresholds = { maxBytesOut = 10000000 }
    }
    # Provisioned tables are tuned by another team.
    "aws:dynamodb-provisioned" = {
      enabled = false
    }
    "datadog:unused-custom-metric" = {
      thresholds = { notQueriedDays = 60, minIndexedSeries = 50 }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether idle rules run for this organization. Off stops collection and hides every idle finding.
- `lookback_days` (Number) Days of metrics each rule judges over, 7–42. Ships as 14. Datadog's unused custom metric rule has its own `notQueriedDays` threshold instead.

### Optional

- `rules` (Attributes Map) Overrides keyed by `pluginId:ruleId` (`aws:nat-gateway`, `gcp:gke-cluster`, `datadog:unused-custom-metric`). A rule left out runs enabled with its declared defaults. Unknown rule or threshold keys, and thresholds outside the range the rule declares, are rejected by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. Idle rules is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) False switches the rule off; leave unset to keep it on.
- `thresholds` (Map of Number) Threshold overrides by key, in the rule's own unit (bytes, counts, percent or days).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_idle_finding_settings.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
